title: The Slap
issue: The opening wastes a few seconds on a glass shatter before the conflict begins.
fix: Start with Victoria slapping Lena at 0:00, shouting, "You dare wear my mother's necklace?"
last_line: ADRIAN: (cold) Because the last woman who wore it died twenty years ago. In my house.

title: The Offer
issue: The final beat hints at danger but doesn’t show an immediate reaction.
fix: Adrian's eyes widen; he lunges for the car door, whispering, "We don't have time."
last_line: Adrian freezes and slowly looks at Lena.

title: Settling In
issue: Neither the opening nor the ending creates tension or a hook for the next episode.
fix: She freezes as a portrait of Victoria turns its head, eyes meeting Lena's.
last_line: She smiles, turns off the lamp and goes to sleep.

title: The Ex Returns
issue: The threat note is vague about timing.
fix: The note reads, "Leave him now, or she'll die tonight."
last_line: On the back: "Leave him. Or she stops breathing."

title: The Gala
issue: The ending resolves the immediate shock without a clear next conflict.
fix: Victoria smirks, whispers, "Now the game truly begins," as Lena's mugshot blazes behind her.
last_line: Gasps. Adrian lets go of Lena's hand.

title: Morning After
issue: The scene ends with quiet resignation and no hook for what follows.
fix: Adrian slides a sealed envelope across the table, saying, "Read this before you go."
last_line: They eat breakfast in silence. Lena sighs of relief.

title: The Hug
issue: The cliff is solid but could emphasize the imminent danger of the syringe.
fix: Lena's eyes lock on the glint of the empty syringe, her breath catches.
last_line: They hug. Over Adrian's shoulder, Lena sees Mrs. Hale walking away with an empty syringe.

title: Confrontation
fix: Adrian's voice trembles, "Lena... I can’t—" as the stairs creak louder.

title: The Explanation
issue: The episode ends with acceptance, offering no suspense for the next part.
fix: Adrian slides a photo across the table, showing Lena's mother embracing Victoria, whispering, "Now you see why."
last_line: LENA: Okay. I believe you. Goodnight, Adrian.

title: The DNA Test
issue: The ending reveals the DNA truth but leaves "It's time" ambiguous.
fix: Victoria hangs up, eyes cold, whispering, "It's time."
last_line: Behind him, Victoria listens at the door and dials a number: "It's time."

title: A Quiet Day
issue: Opening is tranquil with no conflict; ending resolves peacefully, offering no reason to continue.
fix: Lena's phone buzzes; a cryptic message reads, 'We need to talk about your mother.' She freezes as the camera pans to a shadowed figure.
last_line: Lena smiles. The camera rises over the beautiful estate.

title: The Will
issue: The cliff ends with a vague identity question but lacks a visual hook to heighten tension.
fix: As Lena stares, the camera lingers on a sealed envelope beside the DNA reports, its label bearing her name.
